mapper.select:
SELECT permission_id AS permissionId, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_nm AS permissionNm, NULL::varchar AS permissionDc, CASE WHEN permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, use_at AS useAt, created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, created_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_permission WHERE use_at = 'Y'
AND permission_nm ILIKE '%' || #{permissionNm} || '%'
AND ( (#{permissionLevel} = 'write' AND permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE') OR (#{permissionLevel} = 'read' AND permission_code = 'PERM_READ') )
ORDER BY permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_permission ( tenant_id, permission_code, permission_nm, use_at, created_at ) VALUES ( (SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = 'PLATFORM' LIMIT 1), #{permissionCode}, #{permissionNm}, #{useAt}, now() )
